events.name: Autry Pow Wow
events.description: A full-day celebration of Native culture with traditional powwow dancing and songs, Indian tacos and fry bread, and vendors selling Native arts and crafts. Free and open to the public.

events.name: Griffith Observatory Public Star Party
events.description: Volunteers from the LA Astronomical Society, LA Sidewalk Astronomers and The Planetary Society set up dozens of telescopes to view the Sun, Moon and planets. Lines close so all viewing ends by 9:45 p.m.

events.name: Griffith Park Sunset Walk & Talk
events.place: Greek Theatre Parking Lot F/G, 2700 N Vermont Ave
events.description: Observatory staff, urban ecologists and Griffith Park Rangers lead a sunset hike up the Boy Scout Trail to the Berlin Forest. Stops cover park history and objects visible in the evening sky.

events.name: Neighborhood Sing (LAPL)
events.description: A free weekly drop-in community music workshop with participatory singing and mindfulness activities, led by local teaching artists.

events.name: Citadel Outlets Tree Lighting Concert
events.description: Santa lights what the Citadel bills as the world's tallest live-cut Christmas tree at the free 25th annual Tree Lighting Concert.

events.name: Sparkle DTLA Light Show
events.description: Millions of lights dance to holiday music in a free nightly show at The Bloc. All ages (and dogs) welcome.

events.name: Hollywood Christmas Parade
events.place: Hollywood Blvd starting at Orange Dr
events.description: The 94th Hollywood Christmas Parade brings floats, marching bands, performances and Santa down Hollywood Boulevard. Toys for Tots is the official charity.

events.name: Belmont Shore Christmas Parade
events.place: E 2nd St, Belmont Shore, Long Beach
events.description: About 100 entries and more than a dozen marching bands fill 2nd Street for the 42nd annual parade, themed 'Light up the Night!'

events.name: Montrose Christmas Parade
events.description: More than 150 groups march down Honolulu Avenue, and Santa flies by in a Glendale Police helicopter.

events.name: Christmas Tree Lane Lighting
events.place: Santa Rosa Ave & Mariposa St, Altadena
events.description: A mile of century-old deodar cedars, lit for more than 100 years, comes alive at the annual lighting ceremony. The trees survived the 2025 Eaton Fire.

events.name: San Pedro Spirit of the Holidays Parade
events.description: The 46th annual hometown parade with little leagues, scouts, high school bands and equestrian units.

events.name: Chanukah Celebration at the Original Farmers Market
events.description: Music, kids' crafts and a menorah lighting for the third night of Hanukkah at the Original Farmers Market.

events.name: Marina del Rey Holiday Boat Parade
events.description: The 64th annual parade of decorated boats, with carolers, food trucks, a photo booth and kids' art corner in Burton Chace Park and a light show at 5:45 p.m.

events.name: Redondo Beach Pier Holiday Celebration
events.description: A free afternoon with a holiday concert, carolers, crafts, a photo station and a Candy Cane Lane treat hunt.

events.name: Manhattan Beach Holiday Fireworks
events.description: The 38th annual celebration with carolers, local bands, Santa's float, a Snow Park and fireworks over the pier.

events.name: L.A. County Holiday Celebration
events.place: Dorothy Chandler Pavilion, The Music Center
events.description: Southern California's largest free holiday show features folklórico, gospel, mariachi, klezmer, Filipino and Indian dance ensembles. For the first time there are two 90-minute shows.

events.name: Boonion Station
events.place: Los Angeles Union Station South Patio, 800 N Alameda St
events.description: Union Station's free 7th annual family Halloween bash. Expect balloon artists, face painting, crafts, Treats-on-Track trick-or-treating with Metro and LAPD, stilt walkers and a costume contest for all ages.

events.name: Trick or Treat Hollywood
events.description: A free family Halloween street festival with trick-or-treat stations, pumpkin carving, a costume contest with prizes, sing-alongs, face painting and games.

events.name: Paws & Pages Storytime at PetSpace
events.place: Wallis Annenberg PetSpace, 12005 Bluff Creek Dr, Playa Vista
events.description: A weekly Saturday pet-themed storytime with a hands-on craft and a chance to meet an adoptable pet or ambassador animal. Leashed, well-behaved dogs are welcome on the first floor.

events.name: Self Help Graphics Día de los Muertos
events.place: Self Help Graphics & Art, 1300 E 1st St, Boyle Heights
events.description: Self Help Graphics & Art's 53rd annual Día de los Muertos celebration in Boyle Heights. There's live music and dance as ofrendas to ancestors, community altars, art and food vendors, and art activities.

events.name: Rose Bowl Flea Market
events.place: Rose Bowl Stadium, 1001 Rose Bowl Dr, Pasadena
events.note: Tickets online only; no onsite sales.
events.description: The famous Rose Bowl Flea Market, held the second Sunday of every month, has over 2,500 vendors selling antiques, vintage finds and new goods. Early-bird entry runs 5–8:45am and general admission 9am–3pm.

events.name: Lens on Life Film Screening (CD13)
events.place: Barnsdall Gallery Theatre, 4800 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles
events.description: A free monthly screening series from Council District 13 and the Department of Cultural Affairs, held the third Wednesday of each month. Each program pairs films on a local issue with a conversation with experts afterward.

events.name: Winter Festival Toy Distribution & Health Fair
events.place: Salt Lake Park, 3401 E Florence Ave, Huntington Park
events.note: Free; one toy per child, child must be present.
events.description: A free bilingual winter festival with toy giveaways for kids, health screenings, haircuts, kids' activities, raffles and pantry distribution.
know: Haircuts limited to the first 200 people.
